_why: Display names drawn inside the example diagrams, in English. The wiring is defined once in diagrams.sources.json; only the quoted names are swapped, so the two languages cannot drift apart in what they actually demonstrate. A name absent here is drawn as written — kit model numbers and signal types are the same word everywhere.
_colours: Jacket colours are keywords rather than labels, so they sit outside the quotes. kumihimo accepts both spellings; the example should show the one its reader would type.
